title: 150쪽 · Villian (BTN)
sourcePageBasis: capture sequence, checked against surrounding folios
paragraphs: Villain checks. Hero bets $70. Villain calls.

Hero should bet for the same reasons he did on the flop. He shou; expect to get called by Q-x, 10-10, 9-x, and diamonds. There are times when he could check to induce a stab from one of Villain’s floats, but its usually better to go for big value on wet boards.
